profile.headline: Web Programmer
profile.summary:
By February 2017 I completed the University of Texas' coding bootcamp course. The course instructed on the most currently and widely applied systems in full-stack development, such as Node.js, ReactJS, MongoDB, and MySQL.
I have extensive research and presentation experience from eight years as an anthropology and linguistics professor in undergraduate institutions, and I received a Fulbright grant for the 2004-05 season to conduct linguistic research in Mexico. I am thus particularly qualified for and interested in web development in culture-based applications.
I have been writing educational websites about culture since 1996, and since 2014 I have been using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and SQL to populate pages with database-driven content. My professional work at Southern Careers Institute focuses on React / Redux and WAMP applications, and my hobby coding builds mostly upon the MERN platform.
Not currently accepting offers for translation positions.

I updated and maintained materials for the main Crow Haven Corner website, and I have also developed websites for the related phone psychic hotline and animal rescue organization.
I used Adobe Premiere Elements, Photoshop Elements, and Dreamweaver CC to produce video, graphic, and web resources, respectively.

projects.title: Edgar's Mesoamerican Art Page
projects.description:
Written with the WAMP platform, this is the new edition of my first website, originally published in 1996. Subjects may be browsed by historic periods, major deities, or special topics.
This is a single-page app that presents content from GET statements. Most of the parameter keywords are used to prepare SQL queries, to populate the display accordingly.

projects.title: Native American Cultures Database
projects.description:
An open encyclopedia of Native American cultures, initially populated via APIs with content from the Reciprocal Research Network.
Phase 1 complete: full MERN implementation, with basic search and display functionality
Next steps:
Phase 2: Item submission and edition (in React-Bootstrap)
Phase 3: User creation and login
